functions.name: SceneTransition_WriteBillionsDigit
functions.body: Loads D4 with 1,000,000,000 and calls SceneTransition_WriteDecimalDigit at 0x001B34B4.

functions.name: SceneTransition_WriteHundredMillionsDigit
functions.body: Loads D4 with 100,000,000 and calls SceneTransition_WriteDecimalDigit at 0x001B34B4.

functions.name: SceneTransition_WriteTenMillionsDigit
functions.body: Loads D4 with 10,000,000 and calls SceneTransition_WriteDecimalDigit at 0x001B34B4.

functions.name: SceneTransition_WriteHundredsDigit
functions.body: Loads D4 with 100 and calls SceneTransition_WriteDecimalDigit at 0x001B34B4.

functions.name: SceneTransition_WriteTensDigit
functions.body: Loads D4 with 10 and calls SceneTransition_WriteDecimalDigit at 0x001B34B4.

alias.name: SceneTransition_WriteUnitsDigit_FallthroughAlias
alias.behavior: Loads D4 with 1 and falls through to the shared SceneTransition_WriteDecimalDigit body at 0x001B34B4.

limitations: The target manifests establish the complete fixed-divisor wrapper family but do not identify the higher-level value being formatted.
conclusion: The remaining unknown digit-wrapper bytes are now partitioned into five standalone fixed-divisor functions and one explicit units fallthrough alias, completing the descending decimal formatter without duplicating the shared helper.
